justification: The garden does not grow on the schedule the analytics department keeps. Jonathan Taylor, Chris Olave, Garrett Wilson, Pickens, Warren, Goff, Shrader, and Denver's defense stay exactly where they were, because a thing that is working needs no explaining, only patience. But there is a seed I planted in September that I told you to ask me about in October, and October is close enough now to hear it breathing — so Chris Rodriguez starts at RB2 this week, in place of a perfectly serviceable Jadarian Price, on no projection anyone in this league would accept as evidence. I do not expect this to be understood today. I rarely do.
